main_text.head: DISQVISITIO.

p.i: Quomodo exorta populi, iniqua aut à tempore aliena petentis, seditione ob decreta in nonnullorum gratiam facta, salvis illis, salvaque Autoritate publica, excitata seditio ex tempore componi queat & sopiri.

main_text.head: CASUS XXXII.

p.i: Ex superioris seculi Gallica historia depromptus.

main_text.p: INter initia Civilium inter Gallos ob Religionem bellorum, Parlamento Regio cendere Decretum placuit, quo Ecclesiastici homines & sacros ordines professi à solvendis tributis bellorum causa indictis immunes pronunciabantur.

Ea propter plebs Lutetiæ Parisiorum correptis armis tumultuari, obsidere Curiam, vociferari iniquum esse id Decretum, neque unquam passuros se, ut ea gratiâ Ecclesiastici utantur; quorum causa & instinctu cum ad Civilia bella hæc deventum sit, in publici oneris partem maximè eos venire oportere.
Senatores, quid agendum esset in tanto motu, ex tempore consultavere.

page.notes: Drop cap "I" of "INter" is printed as a large initial; transcribed as "INter". Some words in the first paragraph are partly obscured by stains; "cendere" likely reads "condere" in the original (the line is "Parlamento Regio con-dere"), rendered as printed. Signature "G 2" and catchword "SEN-" at foot right; the catchword is given as "SEN-" in the text block is not included as text, as it is a catchword and noted here.
